name: Approval gate
description: Enforces that every outbound action (publish, spend, product create, order action) requires explicit owner confirmation via Telegram/Slack/email before it is executed. This skill is invoked by any other skill that attempts an outbound action.

inputs.action_type: string, one of [publish, schedule_post, spend, product_create, product_update, order_action]
inputs.action_payload: object, the exact payload that would be sent if approved

steps: Reject immediately if action_type is not in the agent's requires_human_approval_for list -- this skill only guards outbound actions.
Compose a human-readable summary of action_payload (what will be created/published/spent, and where).
Send an approval ping to the configured notifications channel (Telegram, Slack, or email) with Approve / Reject buttons or reply keywords.
Wait for a response up to the configured timeout (default 24 hours).
If approved: generate a signed approval_token bound to the exact action_payload hash, and return it to the requesting skill.
If rejected or timed out: return a denial result and do not generate a token. Log the outcome for the weekly report.
Never execute the action itself -- this skill only issues or withholds the approval_token.

config.escalation: Re-ping once at half the timeout if no response.
